variants.prompt: A striking young woman with rich chestnut hair swept into an effortless updo, bright emerald eyes sparkling with curiosity, struts across a luxurious yacht deck at sunset. Her smooth porcelain skin glows under the golden, waning light. She exudes confidence in a leather bodysuit, the glossy black material hugging her curves, paired with high-waisted, studded denim shorts and rugged ankle boots. A silver Celtic necklace catches the light at her throat as she looks out at the shimmering ocean.
